詳細資訊: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ac-VghLU4rsU2PAV6SmzS6wFQxBruPph0U-tRhLg4Hg/edit?usp=sharing
rows.F17:
Skills: 
FFT / Sound Sensor Module / Soldering Breadboard Circuit Design / Hardware and Appearance Design

Description: 
Using a sound sensor module to receive audio data, the Arduino FFT Library is employed to convert amplitude data into frequency (ft). The frequency is then used as an input to control lighting. After noise processing, the stage's lighting ambiance system can change color and flashing speed based on the music's frequency. There are three modes (controlled via button):

Mode 1: 
mixed mode (low frequencies activate mode 2, high frequencies activate mode 3).
Mode 2: 
Adjust bright of the LED (high ft --> brighter)
Mode 3: 
Adjust the frequency of changing left(blue) and right(green) LED light (high ft --> change light color faster) 
Additionally, due to variations in song frequency ranges, two adjustable potentiometers are provided to calibrate the voltage needed for the LEDs to reach their brightest and dimmest states, optimizing the effect for different songs.

More Info: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ac-VghLU4rsU2PAV6SmzS6wFQxBruPph0U-tRhLg4Hg/edit?usp=sharing

rows.A23: 小型空拍機: 電路設計2 (團隊一起) - 2023/02 台大杜鵑花節展品
rows.B23:
[電路設計2]
(H-bridge 過重: H-bridge >> MosFet)
但由於麵包版與H-bridge的重量過重，在詢問學長建議後，我們利用MosFet代替H-bridge，達成馬達轉速能漸變式的調整速度。
(MosFet過熱: 使用散熱片 & 加粗線徑) 雖然MosFet成功減輕了重量，然而由於我們為了有足夠的轉速，使用了高電流輸出的電池，導致MosFet在馬達運行十幾秒時就會超燙。卡了很久，詢問學長後才加了散熱片，達到顯著的散熱效果。 此外，我們也加粗了接到電池輸出孔的電線，因為電流在街上麵包板後會被分流，所以只加粗了電池接線。
rows.E23: Small Drone: Circuit Design2(whole team) - NTU Azalea Festival Exhibit (Feb 2023)
rows.F23:
[Circuit Design 2]
(H-Bridge to MOSFET)
Replaced the heavy H-bridge with MOSFETs for smoother motor speed control after consulting seniors.

(MOSFET Overheating: Added Heatsink & Thicker Wires)
The MOSFET overheated due to high-current battery use. After adding a heatsink and thickening the battery wires, heat dissipation improved, and the system became stable.

rows.A24: 小型空拍機: 電路設計3 (團隊一起) - 2023/02 台大杜鵑花節展品
rows.B24:
[電路設計3] 
(小麵包版>>焊接洞洞板) 由於還是太重，我們將麵包板改成焊接的洞洞板以減輕重量 最後，雖然因為電池仍是太重導致若將電池也放在機體上將會飛不起來，但若電池放在機體下，能夠離地飛起。雖然這次飛行操控的部分因為重量的問題無法達成，但經過這次專題學習到了許多實作層面上的問題，例如散熱片的重要、MosFet、電流的注意、與重量的控制。也反思了解一般小型空拍機的控制都是直接集成在一片集成控制片上的，才能有效減低重量。 (是個實作爆肝回憶起來又一直克服困難充實快樂(?)的一個禮拜，每天早上起來就克服一個昨天覺得無解的東西)
rows.E24: Small Drone: Circuit Design3(whole team) - NTU Azalea Festival Exhibit (Feb 2023)
rows.F24:
[Circuit Design 3]
(Breadboard to Soldered Board)
To reduce weight, we replaced the breadboard with a soldered perfboard. While the battery was still too heavy for the drone to fly with it on top, placing it underneath allowed it to take off.

Although we couldn't achieve the desired flight control due to weight issues, this project taught me practical lessons on heat dissipation, MOSFETs, current management, and weight control. I also realized that most small drones integrate all controls into a single board to minimize weight.

It was a challenging yet rewarding week, overcoming problems daily and learning a lot in the process.

Description:
For the freshman microcontroller course final project, we worked in pairs to create a car that would complete both a line-following and obstacle-avoiding track in the shortest time.
[Line Following] 
Used three IR sensors to read the track and send data to the ATmega328P microcontroller. Based on the sensor states (110/100/000/001/011), the car adjusted its speed in five stages to follow the track.
